status: Published/imported and verified; 50 new unrated candidates. Not an approved party sequence.

selection_policy.grove: Upbeat, fun, happy, hopeful, loving and new beginnings; bouncy, melodic and sexy. No acid/techno; avoid chart-pop/top-five-hit character, sad music and negative central lyric narratives.
selection_policy.hollow: High energy, bouncy, hard, dark and fast; hard bounce/electro, acid hooks/driving techno, rave/trance drive and two psy choices. No dedicated tech-house or new DnB lane this round.
selection_policy.separation: Distinct rooms and moods; limited shared house vocabulary allowed. No duplicate recordings across rooms.
selection_policy.evidence_limit: Lyric themes, editorial sound hypotheses, catalog descriptors and actual-file analysis are separate. No complete exact-edit lyric or full listening certification.

selection_method: Completed host votes and explicit taste anchors; individual exact catalog recordings. Selected Spotify identities/playability refreshed; private previously fetched saved-library pool consulted, with no new full saved-library export or individual membership published. No saved Like confers party approval. Weighted lane spacing and nearby credited-artist separation provide audition variety.

primary_host_anchors: Now U Do — DJ Seinfeld, Confidence Man
feedback_basis.interpretation: Latest batch kept 3/50: Ordinary Pleasure, Ice Cream and Summer In New York. Vocal indie/electro 1/20, melodic vocal club 0/16, percussive 2/10, new vocal probes 0/4. Reduce soft melodic-club/whimsical/novelty probes; test more tactile bass, cheeky vocal hooks, rhythmic indie/electro and percussive movement. Preserve the exact four primary references and individual Float On/Bruises approvals. No genre-wide or artist-wide approval.

audit.listening_status: Catalog identity/metadata checked; no complete audio audition, acoustic identity proof or rendered mix.

privacy_note: Full saved-library exports, personal source membership/timestamps, OAuth data, feedback backups and complete lyric caches stay ignored. Portable candidates contain no individual saved-state flags or lyric transcripts. Artist genre lookups include dated cached API evidence.
